items.prompt: Which city serves as the capital of Spain?

break.interpretation: Ablating the original components raises the target logit under this phrasing, so the original path is not carrying the behaviour; the recorded components are counterproductive here.

layerShiftRescue.interpretation: Shifting the same components across neighbouring layers recovers the effect, so the break is a layer misplacement.

pathChange.interpretation: The replacement path uses components that do not overlap the source circuit.

items.whyStatement: Under the service-question phrasing of the Spain prompt the original path (MLP L3 n983 + attention L0 h6) broke as a sign-flip: the remapped replay drop was -1.0000 against 2.0000 on the source prompt. A layer shift of 1 alone recovered the effect. The replacement search did not find a passing path.
